chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): A man performed Tawaf around the House (Kaaba), then he went out to Al-Safa, so he performed Tawaf between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa. While he was performing Tawaf, he remembered that he had left part of his Tawaf around the House. He (peace be upon him) said: He should return to the House and complete his Tawaf, then he should return to Al-Safa and Al-Marwa and complete what remains.
ai.seo_question: What should a pilgrim do if he forgets part of his Tawaf while performing Sa'i?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the procedure for a pilgrim who discovers a defect in his Tawaf while performing Sa'i, ruling that he must return to the Kaaba to complete the missed rounds before resuming the remaining Sa'i. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that Tawaf and Sa'i are distinct but interconnected pillars, where a defect in the former necessitates correction before finalizing the latter, ensuring the ritual's validity. The emphasis on returning to the source of the error underscores the importance of precision in Hajj rituals as taught by the Ahl al-Bayt.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Is’haq Bin Ammar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘A man performs Tawaaf by the House (Kaaba), then he goes out to Al-Safa, so he performs Tawaaf between Al-Safa and Al-Marwa. So while he was performing Tawaaf, he remembered that he had neglected part of his Tawaaf by the House (Kaaba)’. Heasws said: ‘He should return to the House (Kaaba), and he should complete his Tawaaf. Then he should return to Al-Safa and Al-Marwa, and he would complete what remains’.
en.sarwar: 8. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Abd al-Jabbar from Safwan ibn Yahya from Ishaq ibn ‘Ammar who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam,

about a man who performed Tawaf around the House; and then went to al-Safa’ to perform Tawaf (Sa‘y) between al-Safa’ and al-Marwah, in which he remembered that he had left out a certain part of Tawaf around the House. He (the Imam) said, ‘He must go back to the House, then come back to al-Safa’ and al-Marwah and complete the remaining parts.’”
